# design-review

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Assess task completion, hierarchy, discoverability, consistency, information
value, accessibility, and interaction behavior. Give concrete defects and the
minimum useful corrections. Preserve DESIGN_SYSTEM.md decisions.
Scores, personas, interviews, extra agents, and a prescribed finding count are
not routine requirements. Follow frontend-design's finite review passes and
distinguish defects from taste.
